items.title: In Odesa, no-one is safe from Russia's new Black Sea strikes
items.description: Blackened ships and smashed docks mark Russia's recent surge of attacks on Ukraine's coastline.

items.title: Iran says deal with Oman on Strait of Hormuz is in final stages
items.description: Neither the US or Oman have commented on the proposed agreement on the vital waterway.

items.title: Indian journalist Tarun Tejpal sentenced to 10 years in jail for rape
items.description: Tejpal, who has denied the accusations, can appeal against the verdict in India's Supreme Court.

items.title: Iranian footballers who defied Tehran become Australian citizens
items.description: There were among seven to be granted humanitarian visas while playing in Australia - but the other five changed their minds and returned to Iran.

items.title: Rihanna is 'in the studio', says partner A$AP Rocky
items.description: The singer, who last released a full album in 2016, is in the studio and "cooking", her partner said.

items.title: Outrage as Ugandan football captain beaten to death in street gang attack
items.description: The 27-year-old was killed by suspected robbers after resisting an attempt to rob him, police say.

items.title: Air India's new CEO faces financial and safety turbulence
items.description: The aftermath of last's year deadly crash and mounting financial losses will be Gebremariam's main challenges.
